cases.prompt: A modeled tissue concentration is c(r)=c₀(1−r²/R²) in a cylindrical cross-section. Explain how the radial Jacobian changes the total amount integral and compare it with the center-concentration × area approximation.

rubric.criterion: Uses dA=2πr dr or r dr dθ
Sets radial bounds 0 to R and integrates the profile
Notes that center concentration times area overestimates because concentration falls toward the edge

limitations: This preserved three-criterion checklist is self-assessment, not an analytic grading rubric or an institutional grade.
